notes.title: Final Prelaunch
notes.content:
FINALIZED


After months of fixing this game, we are proud to present the last release of this product, among the features obtained include


  Easy to use Game Controller where players can interact in the game almost without the help of a mouse and keyboard, and only use the game controller


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42429427/6547933f5109c897af9c23ecbe271552358076ce.jpg





  There is a LAN game feature that will add to the excitement and closeness of fellow games in the same environment.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42429427/65d0d258ae3ddd2d682f1c33392cdc68cdd78260.jpg    {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42429427/1633d1d45d90419cecbac6d0992c2d42e6f1f6aa.png




 Power UP in the game which adds to the fun of the game.


We as developers will continue to strive to improve the quality of this game so that users can enjoy the game more



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42429427/3cb04a9fca4eabd1255aa8758cc8dadcdd4f79d4.png   {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42429427/6505646bacf5587100212f1adb456b5afdcfa84a.png    

   {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42429427/051b1dafe063df09f3bd7d251fb4299bd3d5038f.png         {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42429427/c8f7da7ebf013e58a54a246a43481d1ac7132e23.jpg




 Thank you, 
 Autocrusher Bumpercars development team
